IC1: Patients will be excluded if they have had exposure to a total daily dose of MET 1000 mg bid for at least 2 weeks in the past 3 months;
IC2: Patients will be excluded if they could not tolerate  [AND]MET during the recommended titration schedule outlined in the protocol;
IC3: Major neurological or medical illnesses that affect weight gain (e.g., unstable thyroid disease)  [OR]or require a systemic medication that might impact weight or glucose regulation (e.g., diabetes mellitus [ [OR]insulin], [OR] chronic renal failure [ [OR]steroids]);
IC4: Fasting glucose = 126 mg/dL on 2 occasions during screening indicating need for prompt treatment;
IC5: If lab results are available in the last 6 months, then a serum creatinine =1.3 mg/dL on 2 occasions during screening and/or follow-up, indicating potential impairment of renal functioning;
IC7: Children and caregivers who are unable to complete assessments for any reason;
